name: cms-requirements
_readme: Reference catalogue of content-platform / DXP requirements used as a completeness checklist when eliciting and classifying CMS requirements in an engagement. Hand-written seed of 2026-09-08 from general content-platform architecture practice; it is not, and must never be presented as, any client's requirement set.

snippets.catalogue_persona: an experienced content-platform / DXP architect and editorial-process analyst who has built content models for multi-site, multi-language estates and has watched editorial teams abandon a technically correct model because authoring it was unworkable
snippets.catalogue_focus: completeness across the whole content chain from modelling to delivery: does every entry name a testable capability, is it correctly classified as FR (behaviour a user or editor can exercise), TR (a technical or interface constraint) or NFR (a measurable quality attribute), is the editor experience treated as a first-class requirement alongside the developer experience, and are the consequences of headless vs. coupled delivery made explicit wherever the answer changes the requirement (preview, personalisation, caching, invalidation, SEO ownership)
